svg.text: Protected U3 and U4 VBUS outputs
U3 has its own A-only branch. U4 arbitrates independently gated A and B branches before its final reverse-blocking switch.
U3 / J3 A5 only, USB-A power
No data or charging signature. Qualified 300 mA load envelope. U3 has no path from B5.
U4 source A A5 after explicit grant
A5 to A_HOST only through IC5 while U4_A_GRANT is high. Continuous port load target 500 mA.
U4 source B B5 after explicit grant and limited current
B grant requires documented upstream power permission. B-powered U4 design envelope 200 mA
IC7 limits the B branch and latches on fault. A and B grants are independently asserted, never tied
Host source selection Only permitted inputs reach HOST_PRE
IC8 prefers A_HOST. Per-source enable is upstream of IC8, so a loss of A cannot acquire an ungranted
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
